The '''Herios sector''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Star system/Legends|Systems]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Herios system/Legends|Herios]], [[Illarreen system/Legends|Illarreen]] and the [[K749 system]].
